description: This file 'utils.h' contains function declarations and constants for handling JSON messaging and request type conversions in the 'cuttlefish' namespace, used for communication with a socket and mapping between string representations and enum types.

methods.name: SendJsonMsg
methods.description: Sends a JSON message over the specified socket; returns true if the entire JSON object was sent successfully.

methods.name: RecvJsonMsg
methods.description: Receives a JSON message from the specified socket; returns an optional JSON value.

methods.name: StrToReqTy
methods.description: Converts a string to a RequestType enum.

methods.name: ReqTyToStr
methods.description: Converts a RequestType enum to its string representation.

methods.name: StrToIfaceTy
methods.description: Converts a string to an IfaceType enum.

methods.name: IfaceTyToStr
methods.description: Converts an IfaceType enum to its string representation.

methods.name: StrToStatus
methods.description: Converts a string to a RequestStatus enum.

methods.name: StatusToStr
methods.description: Converts a RequestStatus enum to its string representation.
